Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the specific "place of death" information from the search results in the first step. Although the search results clearly displayed the director's name (Edmond T. Gréville) and the IMDb snippet explicitly stated "He died on May 26, 1966 in Nice, Alpes-Maritimes, France," the agent did not report this critical piece of information. Instead, it only confirmed the director's name and noted that the Wikipedia page was present but the death place wasn't confirmed from the viewport. This failure to extract the available data in Step 1 forced the Planner into a redundant loop of repeatedly instructing the WebSurfer to search for the same information, as the data was already visible but unreported.
